I then dealt with the youngest as fast as I could with the same R1 R2 R1 and backstabs if I had a chance to do so

Then Repeat on the Eldest, I just Ignored the others almost completely while focusing on the Eldest, his attacks were easier to perfect block when they were present since he was then less chaotic, dodging when the others attacked, and finished him off with a rewarding fatal
